session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

 **While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

w**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

s**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"

saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

p**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

 **While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

d**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.

`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

 **While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

s**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

i**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

m**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

t**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

O**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

n**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;

Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

 **While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

s**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

.**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

|**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets

and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

r**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

-**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

i**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

n**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.

`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

b**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

,**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

n**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

r**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

c**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

e**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

i**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

,**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

D**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"

projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

**Time limits and Cancel (#276).** Before this, no request in a save had a time limit, so
one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

n**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.

one connection that stalled (VPN, Wi-Fi change, a laptop waking up) left "Saving…" up for
good, and every save after it waited behind it. Now (`lib/time-limit.ts`): every call to
`/api/*` gives up after 60 s ("Cloud Slicer didn't answer"), every Drive call after 30 s,
and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload

and an upload piece after 2 min, which counts as a dropped connection: the page asks
Google how much it has and goes on, and after 5 tries says "Google Drive didn't answer.
Check your connection, then save again." Downloading a project has no limit (a big one
takes as long as it takes). The card has **Cancel** and the menu **Cancel saving** until
the save is being recorded (`PUT /api/projects/<id>`, quick, and the server would keep it
even if the page stopped waiting): Cancel stops the upload and deletes Google's upload
session (no file is made), or deletes the file when the last piece was already in;
the engine's 3MF is dropped when it comes. Saves waiting after it are cancelled too. The
changes stay unsaved, and "Save cancelled" says so.

j**While a save runs.** A Save, Save a copy or Download 3MF the person asked for sets
`busy` and `saving` from the press (also while a save before it finishes first and
while the names are checked) until it is done. Meanwhile a card at the bottom says
what the save is doing, with a spinner and a bar: "Saving… after the slice" (the engine
does one thing at a time, so a slice running now finishes first), "Saving…" while the
engine writes the 3MF, "Saving… 12 of 40 MB" while it uploads, then "Saving… finishing"
("Preparing the 3MF…" for a download). A spinner sits by the project name on every
screen size, and the Project menu greys out Save, Save a copy and Download 3MF with a row
saying why, with the same text and bar. The card gives way to "Saved “name” to your
projects" or the error. Editing stays possible; what changes after the press goes in the
next save.
